encoding: strict UTF-8 JSON, no duplicate keys or nonfinite literals

primary.name: equal_sensor_datatype_source_latency_MAE_ms
primary.aggregation: Equal mean of four sensor x datatype strata. Each stratum includes every declared rat-condition row. Any missing required numeric answer makes the primary value null; coverage remains explicit.

scientific_scope: Processed aligned photometry Figure3 offer/reward timing reconstruction only; no causal, population, raw-optical or full-paper claim.
latency_convention: Source: first global DA max/ACh min, inclusive nearest-grid0..0.5s, first tie, omit partial NaNs without reindexing, one-based within-window index times source dt. Physical absolute-grid time remains a separate field.
xcorr_convention: Full483 lags of xcorr(ACh,DA), pointwise rat means then first-window baseline subtraction, full-vector energy normalization; negative lag means DA follows ACh. No Pearson or lagwise centering.
missingness: All identity rows and fixed vector lengths required for complete/partial. Nullable numeric cells and abstained row statuses are valid unanswered data; full abstention has five empty tables. Undefined source statuses retain distinct meanings.
rank_convention: Source-pooled20/40 condition rows per sensor, preserved source ordering; tie-adjusted continuity-corrected modern normal formula. Not20/40 animals, historical MATLAB or SEM parity, independent-sample validity, or significance optimization. tie_group_sizes lists all equal-value groups in ascending pooled latency value order, including singleton groups; it is not ordered by source row or group size.
